prompt:
Style references only: the attached images set the painting style, the colours and the mood. Do not copy their content. Paint it as a concept artist's painted sketch sheet for a cozy, bright strategy game: loose hand-painted brushwork with visible strokes, soft painted light from a warm sunny afternoon coming from the front right, cheerful bright colours, a warm light cream paper background with a soft painted shadow under each object. It is a painting, not a 3D render, not low poly, not a game screenshot. Cozy and friendly like a storybook toy, never grim. No people, no text, no labels, no numbers, no letters, no watermark.

The sheet shows three round-crowned leaf trees for a toy fortress game, side by side in one row, each standing on its own square grass tile one metre wide, seen in a three-quarter view from slightly above. The tiles lie loose on the cream paper like game pieces, their edges drawn as a slightly darker green line, so the size of each tree reads against its tile. Every tree is chunky and stylized like a toy: a fat short trunk in warm brown carrying one big round crown of leaf clusters in two cheerful greens, the crown about as wide as its tile and the whole tree a little less than twice as tall as the tile is wide. Left: a single straight trunk with a softly domed crown. Middle: a trunk that splits into two short stubby branches, the crown made of three round clusters. Right: a stocky trunk with a wide flattened crown, a little wider than tall. In front of the middle tree, on its own tile, stands a small dark iron cannon on a low square plate that fills its tile: it is the size reference of the game, and the tree must clearly tower over it.
label: round 20 leaf-tree
